content: The parameters of the beam search (see Section SECREF9 ) INLINEFORM0 , INLINEFORM1 and INLINEFORM2 are tuned on the validation set with a beam size of 2500 and a beam score of 26 for computational efficiency. Once INLINEFORM3 are chosen, the test WER is computed with a beam size of 3000 and a beam score of 50.
